findings: Recorded quotation not found verbatim in normalized full-document text.
PDF page 48 is healthcare; measure 91 is on PDF page 34, printed page 32.
Measure describes mortgage credit up to 95% of the property price, not a guarantee of 15% of appraised value.
First-home, ICO and age-at-application qualifications are not stated in measure 91.
Recorded quotation not found verbatim in normalized full-document text.
PDF page 32 concerns secularism; housing appears on PDF pages 113-115.
Replacement draft is limited to the first bullet of housing section c), PDF page 114, printed page 113.
Prior combined rental/vacancy summary and large-holder/tension-zone qualifications require separate source-linked units.
Different instruments were presented as one measure.
Private deposit guarantees and non-intervention claims are unsupported by the cited PP measure.
Placeholder reviewers and a future secondary approval do not establish human review.
findings.decision: Invalidated; no substantive comparison is published.
